messages:
Rachael T.: planning Stormhaven dedicated rollout tonight. proposing quiet window 22:00-01:00 UTC. need pin + explicit rollback criteria. cc @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: deploy checklist for stormhaven/dedicated-slice-17:
• preflight passed (smoke=ok, kvcache primed)
• suggested canary: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% (15m holds)
• config to pin: model=rt-infer-v2, quant=8bit, kernel=auto
• required approvals: eng-release, sre-oncall, customer-ops

Commands to run (ops):
```
redwoodctl pin --customer stormhaven --model rt-infer-v2 --version 2026-03-21-rc3
redwoodctl rollout --slice stormhaven/slice-17 --stages 5,25,100 --hold 900
```

Mike H.: quick q — KMS rotation window overlaps with quiet window? last rotation scheduled at 22:30 by customer. we should avoid key churn during canary.

Simon L.: agree with Mike. if customer KMS rotates at 22:30 then either shift our quiet window earlier by 30m or ask them to delay rotation. also propose adding a fallback model variant (rt-infer-v1) pinned to lower throughput in case quant path regresses.

Anya P.: PM here — customer ok to delay rotation by 45m, they confirmed in email. can we define rollback thresholds? i'll only greenlight if we have clear metrics and rollback automation.

SRE Oncall: propose automatic rollback triggers:
• >=3% 5xx errors for 5m OR
• p95 latency > 30s for 10m OR
• token cost delta +20% for 30m (observability spike)
If any trigger fires, automated traffic shift to fallback variant (rt-infer-v1) and page oncall.

Rachael T.: OK locking on quiet window 21:45-00:45 UTC (shifted earlier). we will ask customer to delay KMS until 00:30. pin command i'll run at 21:40. folks pls ack approvals: eng-release + sre + pm.

Mike H.: ack — SLO guardrails look good. i'll watch canary latency and KV cache hit rates.

Simon L.: ack. I'll stage the fallback and validate model compatibility with current tokenizer. quick sanity run preflight at 21:30.

Anya P.: ack from PM. will notify customer operations and confirm KMS delay.

deploy-bot: noted approvals attached: eng-release=Mike H., sre=SRE Oncall, pm=Anya P.

Rachael T.: running pin now:
```
# pinning model for stormhaven
redwoodctl pin --customer stormhaven --model rt-infer-v2 --version 2026-03-21-rc3 --reason "scheduled dedicated rollout"
# expected response: Pin created: stormhaven@rt-infer-v2 -> 2026-03-21-rc3
```

SRE Oncall: will set rollback automation policy and add runbook steps for pager triage. paging thresholds already noted.

Mike H.: preflight run at 21:30 shows p95=180ms, 5xx=0.0%, kvcache hit 92% — good to go.

Anya P.: customer ops confirmed KMS delay until 00:45. thanks everyone.

Rachael T.: rollout schedule posted to release calendar. starting canary at 21:45. will update thread with each stage. :rocket:

deploy-bot: stage 1 (5%) started at 1768900700. monitor groups notified.

Rachael T.: stage 1 status: healthy after 15m hold. moving to 25% now.

deploy-bot: stage 2 (25%) started at 1768901000.

SRE Oncall: telemetry green. p95=210ms, 5xx=0.2% (within threshold).

Rachael T.: final stage (100%) scheduled at 1768901600 unless any objections. last call.

Mike H.: no objections. full shift at scheduled time.

deploy-bot: stage 3 (100%) started at 1768901600.

Rachael T.: rollout complete. Post-roll checks: p95 steady, errors down to baseline, cost delta within expected. closing out and will file brief release note. :white_check_mark:

SRE Oncall: closing runbook entry. if anything crops up overnight, page via standard pager.

Anya P.: thanks team — I'll send customer summary and release notes.
